# Description

DECTRAX is a cyber deception platform that deploys high-interaction decoys, honeypots, and threat telemetry feeds. This plugin queries attacker IP intelligence, inspects telemetry alerts, and retrieves EDL feeds

# Key Features

* Retrieve real-time attacker IP feeds generated by deception decoys
* Query interaction telemetry and targeted protocols for specific IPs
* Download External Dynamic List (EDL) feeds for perimeter blocking

# Requirements

* DECTRAX instance URL and optional API Key

# Supported Product Versions

* 1.0.0

# Documentation

## Setup

The connection configuration accepts the following parameters:  

|Name|Type|Default|Required|Description|Enum|Example|Placeholder|Tooltip|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|api_key|credential_secret_key|None|False|API Key for authenticating with DECTRAX|None|9d8f3b2a-1c4e-5d6f-7a8b-9c0d1e2f3a4b|None|None|
|ssl_verify|boolean|True|True|Verify SSL certificate of DECTRAX instance|None|True|None|None|
|url|string|None|True|Base URL of the DECTRAX instance e.g. https://dectrax.internal:8443|None|https://dectrax.internal:8443|None|None|

Example input:

```
{
  "api_key": "9d8f3b2a-1c4e-5d6f-7a8b-9c0d1e2f3a4b",
  "ssl_verify": true,
  "url": "https://dectrax.internal:8443"
}
```

## Technical Details

### Actions


#### Get Attacker IPs

This action is used to retrieve list of malicious IP addresses observed interacting with deception decoys

##### Input

|Name|Type|Default|Required|Description|Enum|Example|Placeholder|Tooltip|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|limit|integer|100|False|Maximum number of IPs to return|None|100|None|None|
  
Example input:

```
{
  "limit": 100
}
```

##### Output

|Name|Type|Required|Description|Example|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|attackers|[]string|True|List of attacker IP addresses|["198.51.100.24", "203.0.113.88"]|
|count|integer|True|Total count of attacker IPs|2|
  
Example output:

```
{
  "attackers": [
    "198.51.100.24",
    "203.0.113.88"
  ],
  "count": 2
}
```

#### Get EDL Feed

This action is used to fetch raw External Dynamic List (EDL) plain-text feed for firewall or perimeter blocking

##### Input
  
*This action does not contain any inputs.*

##### Output

|Name|Type|Required|Description|Example|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|feed_content|string|True|Raw plain-text list of blocked attacker IPs|198.51.100.24|
|success|boolean|True|Whether the feed was fetched successfully|True|
  
Example output:

```
{
  "feed_content": "198.51.100.24",
  "success": true
}
```

#### Query Telemetry

This action is used to query deception telemetry events for a specific IP address

##### Input

|Name|Type|Default|Required|Description|Enum|Example|Placeholder|Tooltip|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|ip|string|None|True|IP address to query|None|198.51.100.24|None|None|
  
Example input:

```
{
  "ip": "198.51.100.24"
}
```

##### Output

|Name|Type|Required|Description|Example|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|events_count|integer|True|Number of decoy events associated with this IP|5|
|found|boolean|True|Whether interaction telemetry was found for the IP|True|
|protocols|[]string|False|Protocols targeted by the attacker|["ssh", "http"]|
  
Example output:

```
{
  "events_count": 5,
  "found": true,
  "protocols": [
    "ssh",
    "http"
  ]
}
```
### Triggers
  
*This plugin does not contain any triggers.*
### Tasks
  
*This plugin does not contain any tasks.*

### Custom Types
  
**telemetry_event**

|Name|Type|Default|Required|Description|Example|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|Decoy Service|string|None|False|Target decoy service name|None|
|Interaction Type|string|None|False|Type of interaction observed|None|
|Protocol|string|None|False|Network protocol|None|
|Timestamp|string|None|False|Event timestamp|None|


## Troubleshooting

* Ensure the DECTRAX instance URL is reachable from the InsightConnect orchestrator
* Verify that the API Key has sufficient read permissions for threat intelligence endpoints
